programmes.d: Mark finds himself in grave danger when two unscrupulous detectives searching for a man's long-lost son claim that it's Mark.
A priest claims the marriages in a town are void.
A prospector helps a dentist who has been beaten and robbed by bandits.
The mayor of Deadwood comes up with a manufactured Western hero to lure tourists into his dying town.
A sheriff pursues deadly gunslinger Sam Bolt and finds an unlikely ally in one of Bolt's partners.
Ignoring his brother's warnings, young Roy Bean gets involved in a rivalry over a pretty girl.
Suspicion over a farm and its female owner creates a rift between two mining partners.
Billy the Kid sets out to avenge the death of friend John Tunstall.
Scouts Kit Carson and Frenchy Godey help two survivors of a Native massacre who have lost their cattle.
A likable old miner starts losing friends when his luck takes a turn for the better.
Robert Louis Stevenson is exploring a deserted mine with his son when they discover a Wells Fargo strongbox.
After a settler's son is taken during an Apache raid, an Army doctor leads a small band for rescue.
Opportunist Monte Dunning uses the predictions of a fortune teller to intimidate his fellow miners.
After Calamity Jane joins Wild Bill Hickok's show, her wild behavior causes Bill to question his hospitality.
Doc Holliday, looking for cash to finance his gambling, tries to con a banker out of $20,000.
The skeletons of two prospectors give Ed Schieffelin a clue to the location of a silver mine.
Lured by promises of gold, prospectors provide a wounded outlaw with aid and an alibi.
An ex-convict is hired by Animas City to be their marshal.
Robert Taylor portrays Charles M. Russell in this dramatization of the Western artist's life as a painter.
A psychic leads the way to rescue ambush survivors.
A widowed magician saves his young apprentice.
Robert Taylor portrays Major Horace Bell, a Los Angeles attorney who defends a man falsely accused of murder.
A woman's loyalties are tested when her lawman boyfriend must arrest her outlaw brother.
Warren takes an unreasonable dislike to his stepmother after returning to his father's ranch.
Prospector Jim Otis is taken hostage by robbers after he stumbles onto their loot.
In the new state of New Mexico, a young woman decides to challenge the servitude system in court.
In Apache country, a missionary engages in a philosophic battle with an escaped murderer.
A group of outlaws devise a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.
After Lucas kills a mountain man in a brawl, his father arrives in North Fork to break his other boys out of jail and take revenge on Lucas and Marshall Torrance.
Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon, keeping acting Marshall Ben Waller busy until Lucas is forced to intervene.
After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.
Gavin and Ezra Martin think that Lucas killed their son Clemmie while taking part in a train robbery and Lucas refuses to tell them what really happened.
Eddie's daughter causes trouble for Lucas when two strangers threaten her life after she arrives with criminal information and stolen money.
Town character Brett Conway blackmails Lucas with the knowledge that a young couple Lucas rescued is suffering from yellow fever.
Lucas and Mark are stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water, and after Lucas is injured, Mark becomes the only hope for their survival.
While trying to protect Banker Hamilton's gold, Mark is kidnapped and held hostage at the McCain ranch and will be killed within the hour unless Lucas cooperates.
Lucas makes a life-or-death decision when Micah is held hostage and the kidnappers demand the release of a notorious outlaw.
Lucas tries to do a good deed for the old town drunk but it backfires when the drunk's son believes he inherited Lucas' ranch.
A dance hall singer asks Lucas to care for her daughter in an effort to hide the baby from her self-righteous, bigoted father.
